deviceMode.description: The swagger declares an integer enum 0-4, but its own description and the app use these names.

schedule.description: Weekday (Monday = "0", Sunday = "6") -> seconds after midnight -> temperature in °C. Used with deviceMode Schedule.

temperature.description: Water temperature in °C. Used with deviceMode Continuous.

requestBody.description:
Update Device Mode.
DeviceMode string values are: "SmartControl", "Schedule", "Continuous", "Holiday"
Schedule contains the day of the week as key (Monday = "0", Sunday = "6")

post.description:
Updates the PV settings of a device

From the API's swagger.json (https://wifi-api.id-c.net/api/swagger.json).

400.description: Response when the input is wrong

404.description: Response when serial number of the connected device is not found or if update is not successful

204.description: Device PV settings are updated successfully
